output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM marts.fct_orders o
JOIN marts.dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND c.country = 'DE'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-10-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: This query adds up net revenue for German customers (country = 'DE') from orders placed between 1 October and 31 December 2025. Following the warehouse's revenue rule, it only counts completed orders (is_revenue is true). Cancelled, returned and open orders are left out, and so are shipping fees. The result is in EUR, rounded to 2 decimals.
